in_marathi.name: Prkash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prkash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Prkash is derived from the Sanskrit word prakasha which means 'light' or 'illumination'. It is believed that the name Prkash brings good fortune and success to the bearer. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with the sun god, Surya, and is believed to bestow wisdom and knowledge upon the individual.
